info.title: Greater Banjul Access API
info.description:
Travel-time access to **health facilities** and **schools** in Greater Banjul, The Gambia,
computed with PostgreSQL, PostGIS and pgRouting from OpenStreetMap and other open data.

All geometries are GeoJSON in WGS 84 (EPSG:4326).


**Results are indicative estimates based on OpenStreetMap and other open data and on assumed travel speeds. They must not be used for real planning or emergency decisions.**

Data: © OpenStreetMap contributors (ODbL); Maina et al. (2019), CC BY 4.0; Google Open Buildings v3; OCHA COD-AB boundaries.

get.summary: Assumptions, settings, data sources and counts
get.description: Everything a client needs to describe the results: what was assumed and why.
Facilities used in the analysis, as GeoJSON points (WGS 84). Health facilities combine OpenStreetMap with public facilities from Maina et al. (2019); schools come from OpenStreetMap.

get.description: Land within `minutes` of the nearest facility of `type`, on foot or by car, with the number and share of buildings inside. Time bands: walk 15/30/60, drive 5/10/15 min. Scenarios: base, walk_slow, walk_fast (walking only), drive_congested (driving only).

get.summary: Areas beyond a travel time from any facility
get.description: Land that is NOT within `minutes` of a facility of `type`: one polygon per separate area (slivers under 0.5 ha are left out), with its area and number of buildings, largest number of buildings first. Large gaps can be mangroves or undeveloped land; use `min_buildings` to keep only populated gaps.

get.summary: Nearest facility from a point, with travel time and route
get.description: Snaps the point to the nearest junction of the road network for the mode and returns three features: the `origin` (with `snap_m`, its distance to the road), the `route` (travel time in `minutes` and length) and the `facility`. The walk from the point to the road is not included in the time. The route geometry is null when the point snaps to the facility's own junction (0 minutes).
